disclaimer: Intra / Exitus is a point-in-time entry/exit research model (regime-conditional OU / trend templates with cost-aware sizing). Levels are decision-support, not advice or an order. It abstains when there is no clean, tradeable setup.

plans.rationale: Downtrend; enter on a pullback to the 520.50 anchor with the stop 1.5 ATR beyond the recent swing high (dynamic buffer). Targets at 1.5R/2.5R/4R, kept only within a realistic 30-day move (±24%). Expectancy -0.01R <= bar — watch.
invalidations: A close beyond 581.91 breaks structure and voids the trend setup.
